fullContent:
Kokilakshadi Kwath 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali 
 Introduction 
 Kokilakshadi Kwath is an herbal formulation which is useful in treating Vata disorders. It is available in the form of tablets or in liquid form. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Talmakhana (Hydrophilia) 
 Tinospora (Tinospora cordifolia) 
 Peepar churna (Piper longum) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Make a decoction of Talmakhana and Tinospora and add powdered long pepper in it. Store it in an airtight container away from heat and light. 
 Dosage 
 Take 5 to 10 ml or 2 tablets, before meals, two times daily. When available in concentrated form add equal amount of water to it. 
 Indications 
 
 Gout 
 Joint pain 
 Osteoarthritis 
 Rheumatoid arthritis 
 Inflammatory disorders 
 
 Contraindications 
 
 There are no reported side effects of this medicine. 
 Patients with diabetes should take it under strict medical supervision for a short period of time. 
 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
